page.content:
The Bomber of LIJ's junior heavyweight wing.

How Hiromu Takahashi connects

  • Faction: Los Ingobernables de Japón — Hiromu Takahashi is LIJ's junior heavyweight bomber.
  • Item: IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship — Hiromu made the IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship a Dome attraction.

What is Hiromu Takahashi?

Hiromu Takahashi is Los Ingobernables de Japón's junior ace, a multi-time IWGP Junior Heavyweight Champion whose returns from injury became Tokyo Dome stories.

Key threads lead to Los Ingobernables de Japón and IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship.
